preconditions.description: The length of the encoded word n must be between 1 and 2000.
The length of the string s must equal the given length n.
All characters in the string s must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The decoded word must have the same length as the encoded word.
The decoded word must consist of lowercase English letters.
The decoded word must be the sorted version of the encoded word.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= n <= 2000","description":"The length of the encoded word n must be between 1 and 2000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"len(s) == n","description":"The length of the string s must equal the given length n."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(c.islower() for c in s)","description":"All characters in the string s must be lowercase English letters."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"len(stdout) == n","description":"The decoded word must have the same length as the encoded word."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"all(c.islower() for c in stdout)","description":"The decoded word must consist of lowercase English letters."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"stdout == ''.join(sorted(s))","description":"The decoded word must be the sorted version of the encoded word."}],"invariants":[]}
